## Three Hour Private Catch and Cruise Rates:
Pricing is based up to 6 Anglers both WANU & Swell Chaser 


## Trip Duration:
Maximum of Three Hours
6:00 AM to 9:00 AM or 
9:30 AM to 12:30 PM  or
1:00 PM to  4:00 PM
4:30 PM to 7:30 PM


_____________________________________________
 
## Charter Details:
- Target Species: Assorted Rock Fish, Lingcod, Sheepshead, Halibut, Sand Bass White Sea Bass, Calico, Barracuda and Yellowtail
- No fuel surcharge
- All fish are cleaned by crew
- All Bait and Tackle Included
- California Fishing License's Not Included
___________________________________
 
## About the Boat's:

WANU

**Wanu** is a Custom 32′ Marshall flybridge sportfisher powered by a 250 HP Cummins Turbo Diesel with the latest in digital controls. **Wanu** was specifically designed and built to fish the coastal waters of Southern California. This boat has the speed to get you to the fish and back without wasting valuable time and the range to take you as far out as you want…and then some (600 nautical mile range).

**Wanu** is a United States Coast Guard Inspected Vessel. Which simply means we have the latest life saving devices and the many other required items that make our customers and crew safe while being out on the ocean. Make sure the charter boat you choose is.

**Wanu** is built for comfort and safety. Captain Chris ensures that every amenity is available to you, including a private restroom (also called the “head”). 

**Wanu’s** fully-stocked galley features a microwave oven and coffee maker. When you step on board **Wanu**, her fit and finish demonstrates just how “custom” she really is

**Wanu** was made to catch fish and lots of them. **Wanu’s** spacious fishing area provides the room for EVERYONE to hook up at the same time.Wanu also has a “five-scoop” live bait system and an amazing fish hold to keep your fillets in excellent condition. Along with **Wanu’s** electronics package and top-of-the-line Avet, Daiwa and Okuma tackle, Chris has everything you need to catch the fish of a lifetime.

SWELL CHASER

**Swell Chaser** is a 38' Bertram sportfisher powered by 2 - 375 HP Caterpillar Turbo Diesels with all new gauges and digital controls. **Swell Chaser** was designed for comfort and fishability. This boat has the speed to get you to the fish and back without wasting valuable time and the range to take you were the fish are.

**Swell Chaser** is a United States Coast Guard Inspected Vessel. Which simply means we have the latest life saving devices and the many other required items that make our customers and crew safe while being out on the ocean. Make sure the charter boat you choose is.

**Swell Chaser** is built for comfort and safety. The cabin has a comfortable sofa and extra chairs to relax when going to the fishing grounds. Captain Chris ensures that every amenity is available to you, including a private restroom (also called the “head”). 

**Swell Chaser** fully-stocked galley water, energy bars and candy. When you step on board **Swell Chaser**, how specious comfortable she truly is.

**Swell Chaser** also was made to catch fish and lots of them. **Swell Chaser** spacious fishing area provides the room for EVERYONE to hook up at the same time. Swell Chaser also has a “five-scoop” live bait system and an amazing fish hold to keep your fillets in excellent condition. Along with **Swell Chasers** electronics package and top-of-the-line Avet, Daiwa and Okuma tackle, Chris has everything you need to catch the fish of a lifetime.

___________________________________
## What to Bring:
- Sun Protection: Sunscreen, Hats, Polarized Glasses
- Favorite Food, Drinks, Ice and Cooler for your Catch
- NOTE: Please leave the Cooler and Ice in car
- Also each angler in your party will need to purchase a fishing license from the California Department of Fish and WIldlife. You can follow the link to purchase your fishing license in the confirmation email.
